displayName: DOM Get next sibling XML element

params.name: siblingElemName
params.description: Receives the name of the next sibling element

params.name: siblingElemValue
params.description: Receives the value of the next sibling element

overloads.semanticRole: Navigates to the next sibling of an XML element, returning its reference and optionally its name and value; sets OK to 0 after the last sibling.

jointConstraints.rule: siblingElemValue can only be passed if siblingElemName is also passed (the syntax nests siblingElemValue inside siblingElemName's optional group).

constraints: After the last sibling is reached, the system variable OK is set to 0.
